description:
The FavoriteBikes Hybrid Pro is a Class 3 e-bike powered by a 750W AIKEMA motor with torque-sensing assist. Pedal assist reaches up to 28 mph and the throttle up to 20 mph where local laws permit. A removable 48V 14Ah (672Wh) battery, Shimano 8-speed drivetrain, and Tektro hydraulic disc brakes support everyday riding, while an 80mm air fork and 27.5×2.4 tires help on rougher surfaces.
Integrated lights, app connectivity, a rear rack, and fenders make it ready for daily commuting and weekend rides. Estimated range is up to 50 miles; actual range varies with rider weight, terrain, assist level, tire pressure, and riding conditions.
Favorite Smart System color display integrated into the handlebar. 01. Favorite color display. The built-in LG color LCD keeps speed, battery, assist level, and essential ride information clearly in view.
FavoriteBikes integrated Smart Headlight beneath the handlebar. 02. 1,600-lumen Smart Headlight. A dusk-to-dawn sensor, independent high beam, and handlebar-integrated design help keep the road ahead visible as conditions change.
Frame-integrated Favorite Smart System hardware above the rear wheel. 03. Integrated Smart System hardware. Protected electronics are built into the frame, keeping the connected system tidy, centralized, and part of the bike rather than an add-on.
FavoriteBikes mobile app screens showing navigation and ride information. 04. FavoriteBikes app. Connect through Bluetooth on iOS or Android for navigation, ride data, supported settings, and over-the-air firmware updates.
Hybrid Pro rear wheel with 750W AIKEMA hub motor. 05. 750W AIKEMA motor. Strong rear-hub power pairs with torque-sensing control for responsive starts, hills, and faster commuter routes.
Hybrid Pro magnetic torque sensor component. 06. Magnetic torque sensor. Assist responds to pedaling force, delivering a smoother and more natural ride feel than cadence-only support.
Hybrid Pro GTMRK air suspension fork. 07. GTMRK air suspension fork. Adjustable air suspension with 80 mm of travel absorbs rough pavement while tuning to rider weight and preference.
Hybrid Pro Tektro HD-M285 hydraulic disc brake. 08. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes. HD-M285 2-piston hydraulic brakes provide consistent stopping power with light lever effort and self-adjusting pad clearance.
Hybrid Pro Shimano Altus 8-speed derailleur and shifter. 09. 8-speed Shimano Altus. An RD-M370 derailleur and Rapidfire Plus shifter deliver quick, dependable changes across the 11–32T cassette.

components.description: Removable 48V 14 Ah (672 Wh) lithium-ion, LG/Samsung cells, smart BMS
Favorite Smart System — built-in LG color LCD display + FavoriteBikes app
1600 lm front light, dusk-to-dawn sensor, independent high-beam control; integrated rear/tail light
Promax 15.75" × 1.24" (suspension seat post on select builds)
Cadence sensor + torque sensor; commuting and off-road ride modes; dusk-to-dawn sensor
Bluetooth connectivity for iOS and Android; FavoriteBikes app (speed, navigation, OTA firmware updates)
